text:
ali: Heads-up — we're cutting a small hotpatch for 1.9.1 to roll back the memory leak introduced in 1.9.0. Need minimal diff, version bump, CI green, and changelog. Cutoff in ~40m (UTC). Anyone on call for merge+tag?

maria: I'll handle the changelog entry + QA smoke. Can you paste the exact bump lines?

ali: bump in package.json and helm values: `"version": "1.9.1"` and `image.tag: "v1.9.1"` — keep commit msgs `release: bump 1.9.1` and `changelog: fix runtime mem leak (regression)`.

kevin: I have a tiny revert PR at #4187, minimal diff. CI had one flaky linux/clang test but I re-ran. Can push w/ `--no-ff` if needed. :thumbsup:

sam: quick check — does this require DB migration or rollout choreography?

kevin: No migrations. Just a parsing fix in the runtime that caused KV cache retention. Should be safe for quick cut.

maria: I'll add changelog snippet under Unreleased -> 1.9.1. Short entry: `Fix: revert mem-cache regression causing OOM`. Keep it terse.

release-bot: deploy-checklist created: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/9001 — status: queued (auto)

ali: Plan: merge PR, tag v1.9.1, build images, smoke in staging, then cut. If any test flake or infra problem, call it out here. Cutoff in ~40m; if you can't make it ping me directly.

sam: I'll run quick perf + leak test on staging after deploy, ~15m window.

kevin: merging in 10m once CI green. tagging with `git tag -a v1.9.1 -m "chore(release): 1.9.1"` then push tags.

maria: added changelog + PR comment with QA notes. :eyes:

ali: thanks. If anything blocks, escalate to @eng-sre. After tag, I'll update the release note and notify support to watch for errors.

kevin: CI green, merging. tag pushed. PR #4187 merged.

release-bot: release pipeline started: https://ci.internal/redwood/releases/1.9.1 — build 7844 (started)

maria: staging smoke passed, no leaks detected.

sam: perf stable. looking good. :tada:

ali: cutting the release now. Will post the official changelog and ping #releases after successful rollout.
